Name: Robin Shop Overhaul - Shop Tile Framework
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Do you realize how many things Robin could sell in her carpentry? 
She even says she has several projects. 
Now she sells you some of them. 
And depending on the level of friendship you even get discount to buy these new goods. 

Enter the store and see what's new yourself
Scroll down until you find it.

[b]
I made some modifications to the Mod to fulfill some requests
[/b]
[list=1]
 [*][b]Divided the Mod into parts and put the new items separated by their categories, so what you are not interested can be deleted and the mod will still work with the remaining parts [i](Just do not remove the folder Overhaul It contains the base code of the mod)[/i] 
[/b][/*]
[*][b]I added more items  
[/b][/*]
[*][b]I reviewed the prices [/b][/*]
[/list][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10527/10527-1641349629-2108803364.png[/img][/center]
